description: Eight Bernoulli gates: each takes a trigger and sends it at random to one of two outputs, with the odds set by a knob and four ways of deciding what the random choice does

params.text: Sets the odds for its row, fully counter-clockwise always choosing output A and fully clockwise always choosing output B
Attenuates and inverts its row's probability jack, -1 to 1, before that voltage is added to the probability knob
Chooses what its row does with the random choice: Normal picks an output outright, Toggle turns it into a swap or a stay, Latch holds the choice on without a gate, Toggle latch does both

inputs.text: A rise past 2V makes its row choose again; with no cable the row follows the nearest trigger jack above it that has one
Divided by 10, scaled by its attenuverter and added to its row's probability knob

outputs.text: 10V while its row's choice has fallen on A, and 0V otherwise; in the two modes that are not latched it is also 0V while the trigger input is low
10V while its row's choice has fallen on B, and 0V otherwise; in the two modes that are not latched it is also 0V while the trigger input is low

notes: on the two latch modes the chosen output stays high with no gate at the trigger input, so the module puts out a steady voltage rather than a gate
the trigger jacks are normalled from the top down, so one cable in the first row drives every row below it that has no cable of its own
every jack is monophonic, whatever is patched in
menu: Randomize probabilities — sets whether Rack's own Randomize moves the eight probability knobs
Randomize probability CV attenuators — sets whether Rack's own Randomize moves the eight attenuverters
Randomize modes — sets whether Rack's own Randomize moves the eight mode selectors
